# GitHub

> > GitHub is the world's leading AI-powered developer platform for building, scaling, and securing software with tools like GitHub Copilot, Actions, and Codespaces.

GitHub provides cloud-based Git repository hosting, collaborative development tools, and integrated CI/CD workflows. The platform serves millions of developers and organizations with features spanning code review, project management, security scanning, and AI-assisted coding through GitHub Copilot.

## Key Topics

- GitHub Copilot
- GitHub Actions
- GitHub Codespaces
- GitHub Desktop
- GitHub Mobile
- GitHub Advanced Security
- Visual Studio Code
- Git version control
- Open source collaboration
- CI/CD pipelines
- Code security scanning
- AI code assistance
- Cloud development environments
- Developer workflows
- Repository management

## Getting Started

- [GitHub Homepage](https://github.com/): GitHub homepage: AI-powered developer platform with Copilot and Actions
- [Download GitHub Desktop](https://desktop.github.com/download/): Download GitHub Desktop for macOS (Apple silicon/Intel) and Windows
- [Adding SSH Keys to GitHub](https://docs.github.com/en/authentication/connecting-to-github-with-ssh/adding-a-new-ssh-key-to-your-github-account): Guide to add SSH keys for GitHub authentication and commit signing

## GitHub Copilot & AI Tools

- [Getting Started with GitHub Copilot](https://github.com/features/copilot/tutorials): GitHub Copilot tutorials for VS Code and Visual Studio setup

## Desktop Applications

- [GitHub Desktop Beta](https://desktop.github.com/beta/): GitHub Desktop Beta channel with latest features and bug fixes

## Optional Resources

- [Visual Studio Code Repository](https://github.com/microsoft/vscode): Microsoft Visual Studio Code open source repository on GitHub
- [GitHub Brand Logo Guidelines](https://brand.github.com/foundations/logo): GitHub logo guidelines: Invertocat, Octocat, and product lockups
- [FMHY Repository](https://github.com/fmhy/FMHY): FMHY repository: free media, streaming, torrents, and privacy resources
- [Handy - Offline Speech-to-Text](https://github.com/cjpais/handy): Handy by cjpais: offline speech-to-text desktop app using Tauri
- [frp - Fast Reverse Proxy](https://github.com/fatedier/frp): frp by fatedier: Go-based reverse proxy for NAT/firewall traversal
- [RVC Voice Conversion Releases](https://github.com/RVC-Project/Retrieval-based-Voice-Conversion-WebUI/releases): RVC-Project voice conversion WebUI releases and changelog
